purpose: Unchanged complete native exact-S0 Schur ViT: assess whether a 256-draw full-network SR continuation improves the trained 64-draw parent. Independent full-H direction diagnostics are not selection gates. Frozen child and parent each receive separate fresh 512-draw audits. Full A1 is absent. This is not a matched conventional-ViT or symmetry advantage claim.
optimizer_transition: New preregistered stateless ridge-SR run at identical hyperparameters; trained parent parameters reused, all diagnostic/training/audit seeds fresh. Child optimizer, all RNGs, and subsequent update replay are checkpointed. No architecture or head changes.
